title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function combines the $L_2$ loss with the exponential regularization term. Can you identify the components of this function?

title: Components of the Objective Function
text: The objective function is given by $1/n*abs(Y-X*theta)**2+lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$. The first part is the $L_2$ loss, and the second part is the regularization term.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: The statement claims that the optimal solution is $(X**-1+lambda*I)*X**T*Y$. Consider how the regularization term affects the solution.

hintAnswer: The regularization term is not quadratic so the solution is not simply $(X**-1+lambda*I)*X**T*Y$.
title: Analyzing the Regularization Term
text: The regularization term $lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$ is not quadratic in $theta$. How does this affect the solution?

title: Conclusion
text: Given the non-quadratic nature of the regularization term, the statement is false.
